made_from: The lane journal of a field test, 2026-11-07 01:51:30-02:02 UTC, and the machine samples taken every ~16 s (record: /home/user/var/demo-2026-11-07/). Each run is a booking of that window: when it asked (seconds from 01:51:30), its kind, what admission estimated (the light prior of its command text), and its load as the journal measured it (peak MB) with the load spec's 240 s of work for a heavy task and 20 s for a light one. The demo's load touched its whole block, so every run is hot. outside_mb is the memory the samples show used before the first run (15603 total, ~10000 available); swap_used_outside_mb likewise. Names neutralised.
